title: applyFieldOverrides must not mutate input frames; nested FieldType.frame fields share config with the source query
answers: Panel using -- Dashboard -- datasource shows another panel's displayName/unit/thresholds on every series
Time series to table panel leaks its field config into raw query results
why does defaultsDeep in fieldOverrides mutate shared data
nested frame field config overwritten after applyFieldOverrides
body:
Symptom: a panel reading another panel's results via the `-- Dashboard --` datasource (withTransforms: false) inherits the source table panel's displayName, unit, color, thresholds and custom.cellOptions (e.g. every series named after the table's sparkline column), when the source panel uses "Time series to table".
Root cause: packages/grafana-data/src/field/fieldOverrides.ts:applyFieldOverrides, for `FieldType.frame` fields, ran `defaultsDeep(valueField.config, config)` on each nested field. lodash `defaultsDeep` mutates its first argument, and the nested frames built by "Time series to table" reuse the source query's field objects/config, so the panel config was written into data the query runner and other panels still hold.
Fix pattern: never merge into input objects; build new field objects (`{...valueField, config: defaultsDeep(cloneDeep(valueField.config) || {}, config)}`) and a new frame (`{...nestedFrame, fields: newFields}`) before recursing.
Constraints: a shallow copy of config is NOT enough — defaultsDeep recurses and would still mutate shared `custom`/`thresholds` objects; cloneDeep is required. It costs ~15% on large sparkline tables (5000 rows: 28.7→34.0 ms), which was accepted. Treat any data handed to applyFieldOverrides (and transformation outputs generally) as possibly shared with other consumers.
Test: fieldOverrides.test.ts 'will not write the panel config onto the frames it was given' asserts the source frame's config stays `{}`.
applies: packages/grafana-data field override application, especially nested frame (sparkline) fields and any in-place config merging
